  Details:
  Thread 25178 — Sunmint impact-map tree visibility, root-caused and fixed end-to-end.
  
  ROOT CAUSES FOUND (3, all distinct):
  1. 24 of 25 recent (2026-09-09 walk-about) tree photos were NEVER UPLOADED to sunmint/images/ — referenced by trees/index.geojson but absent (404) -> blank photo in every tree dialog. Originals were still staged on the autopilot box at /tmp/sunmint_up/.
  2. Tree/QR lookup dropdown in sunmint.html capped its list at slice(0,20) in sheet order; the newest 25 trees sit at indices 101-125 -> none ever rendered.
  3. Prod (truesight.me) served a pre-#371 sunmint.html -> plot popup did not list "Trees in this plot (N)".
  
  FIXES SHIPPED:
  - Orientation settled decisively before upload (25/25 staged JPGs correlated against their HEIC originals via pillow_heif ground truth: 22 strip-tag / 3 keep / 0 transpose) so the upload did NOT re-introduce the sideways-photo bug (Bug 2).
  - Uploaded all 24 missing sunmint/images/20260909*.jpg (Contents API; sunmint is api_only_repo). Verified: all 126 tree photo URLs resolve, 0 bad.
  - PR #372 (truesight_me_beta) — Tree/QR dropdown now sorts newest-first and cap raised 20->500. Merged (sha 3b19b0f). Live on beta.
  - PR #371 — plot popup "Trees in this plot" join (beta).
  - PR #426 (truesight_autopilot) — canonical scripts/prepare_web_image.py (+7 regression tests): bakes EXIF orientation once and writes JPEG with no exif block, so pixels/tag can never disagree. Replaces the ad-hoc heif-convert->1600px->q80 step that caused Bug 2. Merged (sha 5cce17a).
  - Also earlier this thread: 18 sunmint/images/boundaries images healed (stale EXIF Orientation -> 1, live-verified 0 bad).
  
  PRODUCTION PROMOTE (governor-approved):
  - sync_beta_to_prod(truesight_me_prod) -> merge success, deploy record deploy_20260911T015528Z_truesight-me-prod.
  - Diagnosed apparent post-sync staleness: GitHub Pages republish was transiently "building" (prior build 2026-09-10 21:51). Confirmed build completed and LIVE truesight.me/sunmint.html now serves the fixed file (75,617 B; all 3 fix markers present).
  
  VERIFICATION: prod live page curl'd post-build (last-modified 2026-09-11T01:56:24Z) with markers slice(0,500), __treesByPlot, "Trees in this plot" all present.
  
  No money moved. Only ledger event = the deploy record.
